form.label: Prusa Watch - Overview
form.description: AI watchdog for the Prusa MK3.5S: verdicts, alerts, printer telemetry and Bedrock cost.

search.query: index=prusa_watch sourcetype="prusa:watch" $job_filter$ | fields _time type job_id state previous_state progress axis_z temp_nozzle target_nozzle temp_bed target_bed fan_hotend fan_print status issue confidence description part_visible evidence downgraded confirm_status streak action subject sent error change_pct latency_ms input_tokens output_tokens cost_usd

index=prusa_watch sourcetype="prusa:watch" type=check job_id=* | stats min(_time) as start by job_id | sort - start | eval label="Job ".job_id." (".strftime(start,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M").")", value="job_id=".job_id
index=prusa_watch sourcetype="prusa:watch" | stats max(_time) as last | eval minutes_ago=round((now()-last)/60) | fields minutes_ago
search type=check | stats sum(cost_usd) as usd | eval usd=round(usd,3)
search type=check | timechart span=5m count by status
search type=check issue!=none | stats count by issue | sort - count
search type=check | timechart span=2m avg(temp_nozzle) as nozzle avg(target_nozzle) as nozzle_target avg(temp_bed) as bed avg(target_bed) as bed_target
search type=check | timechart span=2m max(progress) as progress_pct max(axis_z) as z_mm avg(fan_hotend) as hotend_fan_rpm avg(fan_print) as print_fan_rpm
search type=check | eval confidence_pct=confidence*100 | timechart span=2m avg(confidence_pct) as confidence_pct avg(change_pct) as frame_change_pct max(streak) as failure_streak

search (type=check status!=ok) OR type=email OR type=error OR (type=state state IN ("ERROR","ATTENTION","FINISHED","STOPPED")) | eval detail=coalesce(description, subject, error, "state ".previous_state." -> ".state) | eval confidence=if(isnotnull(confidence), round(confidence*100)."%", null()) | table _time type job_id progress status issue confidence part_visible confirm_status downgraded streak action detail | sort - _time

index=prusa_watch sourcetype="prusa:watch" type=check job_id=* | stats min(_time) as start max(_time) as last_seen max(progress) as progress count as checks count(eval(status="failure")) as failures count(eval(status="warning")) as warnings sum(cost_usd) as cost_usd by job_id | eval start=strftime(start,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), last_seen=strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), cost_usd=round(cost_usd,3) | sort - start
search type=check | timechart span=10m avg(latency_ms) as latency_ms avg(input_tokens) as input_tokens
